assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production character sprite atlas for a local AI office app, not a UI mockup. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells, 2048 by 1024 composition. Exactly 8 characters, equal 4x2 atlas layout; not a collage, no overlapping cells.
